title: The 2 Best Cat Litter Boxes Under $200 in 2026
h1: The 2 Best Cat Litter Boxes Under $200 in 2026
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for cat litter boxes under $200 in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at cat litter boxes under $200 in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: PetSafe ScoopFree Ultra
products.blurb: Key specs: Automatic rake cycle, 5, 10, or 20 minutes after use, Disposable crystal litter tray, Front-entry hooded design.
strengths: Disposable tray system means no scooping and no manual litter changes between full tray swaps
limitations: No sealed waste drawer, odor control is good but not as strong as the CATLINK Luxury Self-Cleaning Litter Box
Crystal litter has an adjustment period for cats used to clumping litter
features: Automatic rake cycle, 5, 10, or 20 minutes after use
